§3§lOptional. Two of them, both raised by the same projection.§r
A 17x17x20 hyperboloid shell on the platform strip to your §bLEFT§r as you stand at the front and look at the silo face - where step 3's plan view draws them. One stands out §bin front of§r the silo face and one §bbehind§r the shell, which is what the panel means by the §bFRONT-LEFT§r and §bBACK-LEFT§r tower. They are §bpieces of the main controller§r, not modules: no tower controller, no dock marker, and no maintenance hatch of their own.

§ePER TOWER§r
  §b736x§r Light Concrete §8(the flare)§r
  §b52x§r Solid Steel Machine Casing §8(the base ring, now a CLOSED ring)§r

§ePER STANDING TOWER§r (maximum two)
  feedwater draw §2x0.5§r
  passive heat decay §2x2§r
  decay-heat demand §2x0.5§r

[note]If you still own a "Plant Module - Cooling Tower" controller from an older version, it is a museum piece: it loads, it has no recipe, and it does nothing.[/note]

[warn]MIGRATION: a tower raised by that old controller has a GAP in its base ring where the controller stood. Break the retired controller and place §b2x Solid Steel Machine Casing§r per tower - the cell it stood in, and the cell directly outward of it toward the platform edge - or the tower will never be detected.[/warn]

[note]The 0.19.0 MAINTENANCE HATCH in that base ring can STAY - the ring cell TOLERATES one, so it is not a reason to take the tower apart. It is §bnot adopted§r: a tower hatch is never counted toward the plant's maintenance, which is the silo face, the Spiral floor and the manifold and nothing else. Replacing it with a Solid Steel casing is equally fine.[/note]

[note]§6A tower that has blocks standing and still refuses to form says WHY, on every panel.§r The REACTOR group carries a §bCooling towers:§r line of its own - §2Cooling Tower x1§r, or §8no cooling towers§r when there are none - and a failing one appends §cFRONT-LEFT tower NOT FORMED:§r or §cBACK-LEFT tower NOT FORMED:§r with the reason. §8That line is on every panel in every state, silo or no silo. It has to be: towers can go up long before the Silo Control Block exists, because that block IS one of the silo face's own sockets.§r[/note]

§3§lTHE FOUR PLANT MODULES§r
Four MORE optional pieces of this same controller, raised by this same one projection, each on a patch of platform no silo tier can ever reach - so none of them moves when you re-tier. They share a §bPlant modules:§r line on every panel, in every state, faults and all.
Each has its own blueprint on the row below: §bVent Stack§r, §bSwitchyard§r, §bExtraction Derrick§r and §bEnrichment Annex§r.

[warn]If this plant is pushing more than §b100,000,000 EU/t§r, read §bThe 100M Wall§r before anything else on that row. Without the Switchyard, every EU/t above that figure is thrown away.[/warn]
